_comment: C0-12 relevance-ai bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（coze），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: The platform connects to each vendor's models (OpenAI/Anthropic etc., official docs line); the specific list has not been verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Pure cloud hosting: the agent team ("AI workforce") runs on Relevance's cloud; no self-hosted form.
axes.local_files: It hosts no local-file runtime — data, attachments and tool outputs are stored and flow inside the platform; the "AI reads/writes local files" form does not exist here (recorded honestly, not "officially not allowed").
axes.background: Cloud-hosted and resident; the official pitch is "build an AI employee team with no code" — multi-agent collaboration is the narrative main axis.
axes.tools: Tools/integrations + MCP (the official docs line includes MCP entries; details not verified item by item).
axes.context: Task passing between agents and shared instructions are the official collaboration surface; cross-session memory not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Team/workspace permission surface is in the official docs line (roles and sharing boundaries not verified item by item); enterprise-compliance claims (SOC 2 type) not verified item by item — "not verified" does not mean "does not exist".
axes.fit: Fits: building "multi-agent collaboration" workflows with no code; sales/operations automation scenarios. Does not fit: self-hosting; code-level control (belongs to framework).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The model list and switching granularity (not verified item by item)
- MCP support details (docs-line entries exist but not verified item by item)
- The current official changelog page (docs sub-paths not verified one by one)
related: Both no-code "multi-agent collaboration" platforms: Relevance leans toward sales/operations in English markets, Coze leans toward domestic distribution chains.
